summary: The conjugation action on characters (`g ↦ (MulAut.conjNormal g).monoidHomCongrLeftEquiv`, a ρ-free `G →* Equiv.Perm (N →* Kˣ)`) is never stated and is instead re-derived ad hoc in four places, one of which is an opaque `simpa` that leaves a double-conjugation cancellation to the default simp set. Also, the relocated `apply_conjNormal_inv` lost the comment that explained its `group` step.
